title: Seminar in Chinese Art; Border Crossing, Chineseness, Diaspora, Exile
description: After considering Chinese art in the Euro-American imagination through the writings of Roger Fry, Francois Jullien, and Marianne Moore, and the artworks by Henri Michaux, Robert Motherwell, and Brice Marden who were inspired by Chinese art, the seminar will explore such critical concepts as cosmopolitanism, cultural politics, diaspora, transnationalism, and visuality as seen through artists in the Chinese diaspora such as Maya Lin, Ai Weiwei, Cai Guoqiang, Chuang Che, Gao Xingjian, Huang Yao, and Zao Wou-ki.
